subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Grafar palavras utilizando regras de correspondência fonema--grafema regulares diretas e contextuais.

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras de correspondência direta fonema-grafema para soletrar palavras corretamente
components.description_en: Apply direct phoneme-grapheme correspondence rules to spell words correctly
components.cc_component_description: Apply spelling rules and patterns to spell unfamiliar words accurately

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre regras de ortografia diretas e dependentes de contexto ao escrever palavras
components.description_en: Distinguish between direct and context-dependent spelling rules when writing words
components.cc_component_description: Apply spelling rules for adding suffixes to base words that require doubling, dropping, or changing letters

components.description_pt: Identificar a regra ortográfica apropriada exigida por um fonema dado em contexto
components.description_en: Identify the appropriate spelling rule required by a given phoneme in context
components.cc_component_description: Apply position-based spelling rules when writing words in context

cc_matches.description: Use conventional spelling for high-frequency and other studied words and for adding suffixes to base words (e.g., sitting, smiled, cries, happiness).
Use spelling patterns and generalizations (e.g., word families, position-based spellings, syllable patterns, ending rules, meaningful word parts) in writing words.
